//allow_ips: Source IPs allowed to reach the bridge. CIDR is accepted. Keep this as tight as possible — anything listed here can execute JavaScript on this Mac.
//ego_browser: Absolute path to the real ego-browser binary. Defaults to ~/.local/bin/ego-browser.
//timeout: Seconds a single ego-browser run may take before the bridge gives up.
//allowed_subcommands: Subcommands the bridge will pass through. Leave import/upgrade out: profile import and app upgrade are the Mac user's job.
